scope: ordinary init dialect/derived/source preservation; no G1/G3 completion

exact_contract.title: Preserve XML host dialect and derived dependency state during init
exact_contract.goal: Make vibe init package add its own slot without converting the host XML boot lane or writing generated state into vibedeps.
steps: Reproduce init package in a disposable xml-spec_format project with existing STATIC.xml/INDEX and generated instruction blocks; capture host and derived dependency bytes before the command.
Carry the selected host dialect into boot regeneration or skip it when unnecessary; never default this path to Mixed/STATIC.md and never treat a vibedeps slot as a write target.
Characterize scaffold tool format/link defaults and static marker spelling against declared options and update only their documented mismatch.
positive_cases: The new package slot is present; host STATIC.xml and instruction blocks still name XML, and vibedeps remains byte-identical.
The same command remains correct for a Markdown-lane host.
negative_cases: Init package removes STATIC.xml or rewrites a dependency slot boot lane.
A quiet successful command hides a host dialect change or writes into derived dependencies.
checks: SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: bind the affected vibe-workspace/vibe-cli/vibe-spec target and exact regression cases from source before compiling; use --lib or a named integration target.
RUN BOUND CHECKS: cargo test -p vibe-workspace --lib <reviewed case> -- --exact or the corresponding affected named target; require one nonzero selected case.
CONDITIONAL ORACLE: run codegen/specmap only if a changed schema, generator, source index or dependent contract actually requires it; do not use a broad gate from write perimeter alone.
acceptance: Make vibe init package add its own slot without converting the host XML boot lane or writing generated state into vibedeps.
Disposable positive and negative evidence is reviewed; any unavailable native Windows proof remains open rather than waived.
exact_contract.safe_stop: Keep the regression reproducible in a disposable fixture and report exact unsupported behavior until the affected path is fixed.
exact_contract.commit_subject: fix(init): preserve XML host boot dialect
notes: Product-neutral regressions observed on a separate local main are hypotheses for this next checkout until disposable current-tree tests prove them. Do not copy fixture-specific package names or publish external package sets.
Maintain the mutable 1.1.0 cohort and the no-public-Git hold. Bind only affected tests; no mutation suite or routine whole-workspace gate.
